claim: Every persisted thread carries a routing ledger: a table with one row per topic the thread touches, holding the strand state (open, paused, closed), the dispatch pointer (the proto-belief document the strand's content routed to, or unrouted), and the dangling question when one is pending. Synthesized content always lands in proto-belief documents, never in the ledger; the ledger carries only pointers and states, so it cannot become a digest of the thread or a shadow copy of the proto-belief documents. A multi-topic thread is resumed by reading its ledger, not by replaying the conversation or trusting memory.
